name: api-null-normalization
goal: Compare nullable nondeterministic API fields without hiding type differences.

evidence: Matching null values in a declared nondeterministic API field are rejected even though null and missing or non-null values must remain distinct.
The existing json method case covers strings, arrays, missing fields and invalid paths but never normalizes a nullable field. Extend that same case with matching and mismatched null values.
Committed case 545e4d70d8 rejected matching null fields; record 3049aa4a2e96.
Commit 25199c7195 leaves null intact and still rejects objects or mismatched JSON types.
Unchanged JSON case passed at 25199c7195 with paired record 91cffb5b6a56.
